entries.test: Public audience and retention data, together with studies of Facebook's engagement incentives, could establish whether prioritizing content and interactions over curation is causing sustained user decline.
entries.note: The surrounding discussion includes AI-generated images. In context, 'slowly killing' has a plain reading of causing sustained decline.
'No duty toward its users' has no clear factual meaning here: it could mean absent obligations, indifference, or inadequate enforcement. Those interpretations require different causal tests.

entries.test: Representative Facebook content audits and contemporaneous audience trends across Meta's products could test the claimed prevalence of AI engagement bait and ongoing product decline.
entries.note: The source refers to Meta's family of products; the proposition shifts ownership of those products to Facebook. The later audience figures give the decline claim an empirical reading.

entries.test: Meta's May 2024 product documentation and reproducible interface tests could establish Meta AI's availability across Facebook properties and whether users could disable it.
entries.note: The claim concerns availability and controls at publication, not their current state.

The preceding sentence supplies the attributed purpose of keeping users on Meta's platforms. The proposition makes that private purpose central, rather than merely claiming measurable engagement effects.
This is a broad evaluation of the features' worth, harm, and intrusiveness without specified factual criteria.
The central assertion is that the spending is senseless waste. The forecast revision is a separately checkable supporting fact, but cannot settle that judgment.

The source tentatively attributes intent to Zuckerberg and links 'doing the same' to over $40 billion in metaverse spending. The proposition substitutes Meta and reduces that comparison to unspecified billions.

entries.test: Sustained audience contraction followed by Facebook's closure or abandonment, alongside comparable Instagram decline as Meta encounters difficulties, would test the predicted outcomes.
entries.note: The proposition omits the condition tying Instagram's decay to difficulties at Meta, although the separate conditions field preserves it. The passage combines an unconditional Facebook forecast with a conditional Instagram forecast.
